data.body: Epic 7e9e: BLOCK T8 CRITICAL — ${run:operation} declared in the closed vocabulary but its VALUE SET was never enumerated, and the epic's prose said 'code-review' where rebar's canonical identifier is 'review-code'. A vocabulary mismatch would emit wrong header values. Remediated across three tickets: operation now resolves to exactly review-plan | verify-completion (rebar's CLI verb names, not invented spellings like plan_review); review-code explicitly absent because it opens no gate scope, which is why the omit rule exists; identifier corrected in epic criterion 7, 6cd0's literals and ACs, and 26ae's prose. Re-reviewing 6cd0 then the epic in dependency order.
